thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-6487 triggered — High HTTP 5xx error rate on inference-gateway-us-west2. Alert rule: Fractional 5xx > 4% over 5m. Current: 11.2%. Triggered at 02:33:41 UTC. Routed to: oncall-liz, sre-jen.

oncall-liz: Acked INC-6487. I’m on it — checking dashboards and recent deploys.

sre-jen: Looking at edge+upstream metrics now. 5xx are mostly 502/504. Spike aligns with increased backend latency and a kvcache eviction burst around 02:31.

runtime-mike: I see many upstream timeouts in NGINX logs to pool-17 backends. No new model deploys in the last 24h. There was a config tweak around 02:10 (traffic slicing experiment). Pulling logs.

pm-carla: Any immediate customer impact? Which routes are affected? We need to prepare comms if this persists.

support-elena: Support queue: multiple reports for /v1/generate errors. Ticket #4567 for AcmeCorp (high priority) — they report 502s starting ~02:38 PST.

oncall-liz: Runbook step: confirm canaries -> check routing -> isolate suspect pool. Canaries look fine. I'll try draining pool-17 from the rotator to see effect.

runtime-mike: Quick checks:
```
# internal health
curl -sS http://inference-gw-usw2.internal/health
# sample failing request
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Health endpoint returns 200, /v1/generate returns 502 with upstream reset. Attaching trimmed nginx log lines: `upstream: "http://10.2.17.5:8080/" failed (111: Connection refused) while reading response header`.

sre-jen: Kernel OOM/oom_kill not seen, but there are a lot of TCP RSTs from backend. My hunch: connection keepalive change + high concurrency causing backend process overload/handshake failures.

oncall-liz: Initiated traffic shift: `rbctl set-weight pool-17 0.0` (drain). Logging action.

incident-bot: Action recorded: traffic shift initiated by oncall-liz at 02:39:12 UTC. PagerDuty note appended.

runtime-mike: Pool-17 draining. Error rate dropped from 11.2% -> 6.1% in first minute. Continuing to monitor.

pm-carla: Sending initial customer advisory: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx errors for inference requests in us-west2; mitigation in progress; next update in 15 minutes."

support-elena: Update: AcmeCorp confirms errors reduced on their side after ~02:42 PST. They've paused heavy jobs.

sre-jen: I can repro connection resets when backend threads exceed ~800 concurrent connections with the current keepalive config. Reverting the keepalive tweak on one host to validate. Command: `ssh node-17-02 sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=7200`.

oncall-liz: Reverted keepalive on node-17-02 and 17-03. Rolling change across pool-17.

runtime-mike: After revert and drainage, global 5xx dropped to 1.3% in 10m. Latency on backends normalized.

pm-carla: Great — please prepare a short incident blurb for customers: cause hypothesis + mitigation + next steps. I'll coordinate external comms.

sre-jen: Root cause hypothesis: experimental keepalive/conn-reuse tweak combined with kvcache eviction surge led to backend connection resets under high concurrency. Action items: 1) Rollback experiment across pool-17; 2) Add a canary and load-test for connection churn; 3) Postmortem with timeline and config diff.

oncall-liz: I'll hand off to next oncall in 15m after ensuring error rate stable <2% for 20m. Documenting steps in incident doc.

pagerduty-bot: INC-6487 status changed: acknowledged -> resolved by oncall-liz at 02:53:00 UTC.

support-elena: Notified affected customers that errors subsided and that we're doing follow-up. Ticket #4567 updated.

incident-bot: Incident closed in Slack thread. Follow-up: schedule postmortem and patch rollout. Tags: inference-gateway, pool-17, networking, kvcache.

oncall-liz: TL;DR: 5xx spike caused by connection-reset wave on pool-17 after an experimental keepalive change. Mitigation: drained pool and reverted the tweak; traffic restored to healthy pools. Next: infra rollback + controlled rollout with increased conn limits. On-call handoff queued to next shift.

sre-jen: Adding note: collect tcpdump on one node for deeper analysis, and correlate with kvcache eviction logs.

pm-carla: Thanks all — I'll draft the customer note and postmortem template.

runtime-mike: Leaving final commands run in case useful: `rbctl set-weight pool-17 0.0 && for node in $(rbctl list-nodes pool-17); do ssh $node sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=7200; done`

oncall-liz: Handing off to oncall-liz (next shift) — keeping this thread pinned for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:"
